name: DrisBlueTwentyThree
description: Driscoll's blueberry cultivar, trade name Rosita. Its Canadian plant breeders' rights examination is one of the few blueberry records in this package resting on a stated replicated trial design: a randomised complete block of four replicates of three plants per variety at Chilliwack, British Columbia, in the 2023 season.

attributes.rights: Canada plant breeders' rights certificate 7211, granted 1 November 2024

traits.conditions: Comparative trial by Expert Agriculture Team Ltd., Chilliwack, British Columbia, 2023 growing season; randomised complete block, 4 replicates x 3 plants, measurements from 10 plants; comparison varieties 'DrisBlueSeven' and 'DrisBlueTwentyTwo'
traits.asserted_by: Expert Agriculture Team Ltd. for the Canadian Food Inspection Agency
